tei:div.tei:p: bla ma bde mchog 'khor lo'i sngags don ni/ rdo rje phreng bar/ oṃ ni ye shes snying po ste/ /rdo rje'i sku ni thob byed pa'o/ /āḥni byang chub dpag med pas/ /rdo rje'i gsung ni thob byed pa'o/ /hūm̐ ni sku gsung thugs nyid do/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum thob pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid/ /padma bde ba thams cad kyi 'byung gnas stong nyid shes rab kyi cha rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha'/ badzra stong pa'i ye shes nam mkha'i gzugs can de rgyud la 'dren byed thabs kyi cha yab he ru ka'i rdo rje/ ma hā su kha thabs shes sam yab yum gnyis med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan thugs zag med dngos po kun gyi khyab bdag dpal 'khor lo sdom pa ba'i mtshan nas bskul te/ sarba siddhi mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad/ hrīḥzhes thugs srog gting nas bskul bas bos te bdag la stsol/ ha ha gnyis ni rang bzhin chos nyid dang lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po'i don sa bon gyi rigs yin/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ni rdo rje rtse mo las/ yi ge hūm̐ ni ci yin brjod/ /sdug bsngal bcom zhing 'joms par byed/ /srid pa'i zhags pa gcod byed cing*/ /gdug pa sdang zhing gsod byed pa'i/ /hūm̐ ni mchog tu dran par bya/ /zhes pa ltar 'khor ba'i 'bras bu 'khrul snang sdug bsngal bden pa 'joms pa dang*/ srid pa'i rgyu kun 'byung las nyon kyi zhags pa gcod pa'i don dang*/ phaṭ:ni rdo rje rtse mo las/ yi ge phaṭ ni ci yin brjod/ bdud dang sdug bsngal 'joms byed cing*/ /bde na ngag ni 'gugs par byed/ /ces pa ltar gnyen po lam bden gyis bdud bzhi 'joms shing theg chen 'gog bden zag med spang rtogs rgyud la 'gugs pa'i don yin no/ ༈ /yang*/ oṃ ni dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs ye shes lnga mtshon byed bkra shis pa'i sngags yin pas sngags thams cad kyi thog mar 'byung*/

padma ni gu ru rin po che'i mtshan/ 'jig rten na padma mdzes shos yin pa bzhin gu ru rin po che sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' drin che shos yin/ padma mig gis mthong ba dang sems dga' ba dang*/ dri zhim pa/ mgo dang rna ba'i rgyan byas na mdzes pa bzhin gu ru rin po che'i sku mjal na sems dga' ba/ mtshan thos pa dang yid la dran pa tsam gyis ngan song las skyob pa/ gu ru rin po che la gsol ba btab na dgra gdon bar chad thams cad skyob par mdzad pa/ tshe ring ba/ nad med pa/ phas rgol gyis gnod mi nus pa phyi ma bde ba can du skye ba sogs dad pas gsol ba ci 'dod btab pa de bzhin 'byung ba/ gu ru de yi dam bde mchog gi skur bzhengs pa de ni zhi ba'i gnas skabs su rdo rje sems dpa' de yin pas badzra de nyid yi dam khro bo'i skur bzhengs pa rnying mas yang dag /gsar mas bde mchog tu grags/ rgya gar gyi grub chen phal mo che'i thugs dam gyi lha bde mchog yin/ /gu ru rin po ches bal yul yang le shod nas yang dag bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs te rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur pa dang*/ rje btsun mi la ras pa grub pa thob byed kyang bde mchog yin/ bde mchog gi sngags la/ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces grags/ sngags 'di dad pas bzlas pa kho nas ting nge 'dzin ma shes kyang phyi ma dag pa mkha' spyod du skye bar gsungs/ des na bla ma gu ru rin po che/ yi dam bde mchog /mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo thams cad kun 'dus kyi sngags yin pas/ 'di bzlas na tshe ring*/ gdon gyis mi gnod/ bsod nams che/ bar chad thams cad skyob/ phyi ma dag pa mkha' spyod du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis khrid/ nyams dang rtogs pa thams cad skye/ hūm̐ zhes pa ni gu ru rin po che/ bde mchog /rdor sems thams cad kyi thugs kyi sa bon mi yi rnam shes lta bu yin no/ ༈ /aḥ zhes chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don mdor bstan te/

sems can gyi 'khrul snang ma dag 'khor ba'i gnas skabs su/ sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ dang sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi rgyu 'bras kyi 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi snang cha'i bla ma bde mchog 'khor lo'i gzugs sku rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ lha: ngo bo'i gnas lugs dag pa myang 'das kyi 'bras bu thams cad sems nyid gdod nas skye ba med pa'i klong: nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar dbyings su chos sku ka dag gi ngang du thim: de ni blos bsam gyis mi khyab ngang du so so rang rig pa'i spyod yul du mi g.yo bar bzhag: a a a: sku gsung thugs dbyer med pa'i gsang ba sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i/ oṃ sku āḥ gsung hūm̐ thugs padma shes rab rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid e yi don/ badzra thabs bde ba chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i waṃ ma hā su kha de gnyis zung 'jug gi don rtogs na khyab bdag 'khor lo sdom pa kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi lhag pa'i lhas sarba siddhi mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad hrīḥ ni thugs srog nas bos te rtse gcig ha ha bde ba chen po'i gnas kyi thugs tshims te bzhad pa'i sgra/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ gnyis yab yum gyi thugs srog bskul/ phaṭa: bzung 'dzin gtor ba'i don no/ /maṅga las so// //
